current.assessment: Mostly supported outline of the shared-town/psionic-goblin transition. Calling first-half enemies distractions or minor players in the larger conspiracy overstates what is established.

verified_connections: Early psionic goblin clues foreshadow the later shard hunt.
A psionic goblin corpse in W1 links the cave to the scouts; the source explicitly says they found no obelisk shards.
Chapter 4 closing gives return-to-Phandalin motives including escorting Nundro and a ten-percent mine-profit stake.
Chapter 5 opens with new goblin crimes; investigation leads to Ruxithid and the broader mind flayer scheme.
The transition passages do not establish the Forge as the source of the obelisk ritual or Nezznar as an agent of the mind flayers.
